title: ze_challenge_run
description:
Challenged ze map emphasized teamwork, need cs2fix to run the map
Most of human need to defend in the start zone first, while a few people will get into the teleport on the side of the start zone, they need to trigger the mechanisms to help human get to the end. Once people get into the teleport triggered all the things, they can touch the green button in the little room at the end to open the starting gate.
Zombie can also trigger the traps to stop human get to the end.
